direct_official_checks: OSGM15 transforms ETRS89 ellipsoid height to orthometric height
mainland Britain output is Ordnance Datum Newlyn
geoid separation is obtained by bilinear interpolation
nominal mainland geoid-model accuracy is 8mm RMS
other areas use different local vertical datums
OS recommends OSGM15 with OS Net for high-accuracy orthometric heighting
OSGM15 transformation accuracy is not terrain-surface accuracy
quality_effect: Prevents geoid-transformation precision from being misreported as DTM or parcel-elevation precision.
